name: BucketCountPolicyAllowsUnencryptedObjectUploads
description: Provides information about the number of S3 buckets whose bucket policies do or don't require server-side encryption of objects when objects are added to the buckets.

allOf.description: The total number of buckets that don't have a bucket policy or have a bucket policy that doesn't require server-side encryption of new objects. If a bucket policy exists, the policy doesn't require PutObject requests to include a valid server-side encryption header: the x-amz-server-side-encryption header with a value of AES256 or aws:kms, or the x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm header with a value of AES256.

The total number of buckets whose bucket policies require server-side encryption of new objects. PutObject requests for these buckets must include a valid server-side encryption header: the x-amz-server-side-encryption header with a value of AES256 or aws:kms, or the x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm header with a value of AES256.

The total number of buckets that Amazon Macie wasn't able to evaluate server-side encryption requirements for. Macie can't determine whether the bucket policies for these buckets require server-side encryption of new objects.
